english: This investment pays off wonderfully, with research centers such as the International Rice Research Institute and the International Maize and Wheat Improvement Centre providing the high-yield seeds and innovative farming strategies that together triggered the Asian Green Revolution.
mandarin: 有了如国际水稻研究所和国际玉米及小麦研究所这些提供高产种子和创新农业战略，并共同引发了亚洲“绿色革命”的研究中心，这种投资的回报极为可观。

english: These centers are not household names, but they deserve to be.
mandarin: 这些中心并非人尽皆知，但它们的确是无名英雄。

english: Their scientific breakthroughs have helped to feed the world, and we’ll need more of them.
mandarin: 它们的科学突破帮助我们养活了全世界的人口，这样的机构应该更多一些。

english: Dozens of low-income, food-deficit countries, perhaps as many as 40-50, have elaborated urgent programs for increased food production by small farms, but are currently held back by the lack of donor funding.
mandarin: 数十个低收入、粮食赤字的国家（可能有四十到五十个）已经宣布了旨在增加小农场粮食产量的紧急计划，但却由于缺少捐助方的资金支持而力不从心。

english: These countries have appealed to the World Bank for financing, and the Bank made a valiant effort in 2008 to help through its new Global Food Crisis Response Program (GFCRP).
mandarin: 这些国家向世界银行请求融资，而该行在2008年也不遗余力地通过其新的“全球粮食危机响应计划 ” ( GFCRP) 提供了帮助。

english: But the Bank does not yet have sufficient funds to meet these countries’ urgent needs, and has had to ration assistance to a small fraction of the flows that could be effectively and reliably used.
mandarin: 但世行资金在满足这些国家的紧急需求方面也是捉襟见肘，并不得不对援助资金进行配额限制，使得其数额相对于原本所需的可靠而有效资金量而言只是杯水车薪。

english: Hundreds of millions of people, in the meantime, remain trapped in hunger.
mandarin: 同时，近十亿人则在饥饿中挣扎。

english: Many individual donor countries have declared that they are now prepared to increase their financial support for smallholder agriculture, but are searching for the appropriate mechanisms to do so.
mandarin: 许多捐助国都各自宣称正准备增加对小型农业的资金支持，但现在正寻求一种合适的实施机制。

english: The current aid structures are inadequate.
mandarin: 目前的援助架构尚有欠缺。

english: The more than 20 bilateral and multilateral donor agencies for agriculture are highly fragmented and of insufficient scale individually and collectively.
mandarin: 二十余家双边和多边的农业援助机构则高度分散，其规模不论个体还是集体都尚显不足。

english: Despite the dedicated efforts of many professionals, the response to the hunger crisis remains utterly inadequate.
mandarin: 尽管许多专业人士付出了巨大的努力，但对饥饿危机的响应仍然远远不足。

english: The 2008 planting seasons came and went with much too little additional help for impoverished small farmers.
mandarin: 2008年的种植季节来了又去，贫穷的小农户们在此期间所获得的额外援助仍是少之又少。

english: African countries search endlessly, and mostly fruitlessly, for the small amounts of funding needed for their purchases of fertilizer and improved seeds.
mandarin: 非洲国家无尽地，也几乎无果地寻求着购买化肥和良种所需的小额资金。

english: My colleagues and I, serving on an advisory committee for the Spanish initiative, have recommended that donors pool their funds into a single international account, which we call the Financial Coordination Mechanism (FCM).
mandarin: 作为西班牙政府此项计划的顾问委员会成员，我和我的同事们建议捐助方将他们的资金集中到同一个被我们称为“融资协调机制(FCM ) ” 的国际账户。

english: These pooled funds would enable farmers in poor countries to obtain the fertilizer, improved seed varieties, and small-scale irrigation equipment that they urgently need.
mandarin: 这些集中起来的资金能让贫穷国家的农民获得急需的化肥、良种和小型灌溉设备。

english: Poor countries would receive prompt and predictable financing for agricultural inputs from a single account, rather than from dozens of distinct and fragmented donors.
mandarin: 穷国能从一个统一账户而不是数十个各自为政且高度分散的捐助方获得即时和可预见的农业投入融资。

english: By pooling financial resources into a single-donor FCM, aid programs’ administrative costs could be kept low, the availability of aid flows could be assured, and poor countries would not have to negotiate 25 times in order to receive help.
mandarin: 通过将财政资源集中到一个统一的捐助方FCM，可以保持较低的援助计划行政成本，援助资金流的持续性也能得到保证，而穷国也不必为了获得援助而进行二十五次谈判。

english: The time for business as usual is over.
mandarin: 按部就班的时代一去不返。

english: The donors promised to double aid to Africa by 2010, but are still far off track.
mandarin: 捐助方承诺到2010年将援助资金增加一倍，但现在仍是任重道远。

english: Indeed, during the past 20 years, they actually cut aid for agriculture programs, and only now are reversing course.
mandarin: 的确，在过去的二十年里，他们实际上削减了农业计划的援助资金，直到现在才开始回到正轨。

english: Meanwhile, a billion people go hungry each day.
mandarin: 与此同时，十亿人却每天生活在饥饿的阴影之中。

english: We need a breakthrough that is demonstrable, public, clear, and convincing, that can mobilize the public’s hearts and minds, and that can demonstrate success.
mandarin: 我需要一种突破，它具有示范效应，公开、明晰并具有说服力；它能激发公众的身心投入，并彰显成功。

english: History can be made in Madrid at the end of January, when the world’s richest and poorest countries converge to seek solutions to the global hunger crisis.
mandarin: 当世界上最富裕和最贫穷的国家在一月底齐心协力寻求全球饥饿危机的解决之道时，我们就能在马德里创造历史。

english: The lives of the billion poorest people depend on it.
mandarin: 十亿最贫穷人口的生命皆系于此。

english: A Breakthrough Opportunity for Global Health
mandarin: 全球卫生状况的突破性机会

english: NEW YORK – Every year, millions of people die from preventable and treatable diseases, especially in poor countries.
mandarin: 纽约—每年都有数百万人因可防可治的疾病而身亡，特别是在穷国。

english: In many cases, lifesaving medicines can be cheaply mass-produced, but are sold at prices that block access to those who need them.
mandarin: 在很多情形中，救命药可以以低廉的成本大量生产，但售价却让需要者望而却步。

english: And many die simply because there are no cures or vaccines, because so little of the world’s valuable research talent and limited resources is devoted to addressing the diseases of the poor.
mandarin: 更有许多人的死仅仅是因为缺少治疗或疫苗，而造成这种情况的原因是用于为穷人治病的世界宝贵研究人才和有限资源太少。

english: This state of affairs represents a failure of economics and law that urgently needs to be corrected.
mandarin: 如此状况反映了经济学和法律方面急需得到修正的失灵。

english: The good news is that there are now opportunities for change, most promisingly through an international effort headed by the World Health Organization that would begin to fix the broken intellectual-property regime that is holding back the development and availability of cheap drugs.
mandarin: 好消息是现在改变的机会已现，主要是通过一项由世界卫生组织牵头的国际计划，该计划将开始修正造成廉价药品开发和难以获得问题的知识产权制度漏洞。

english: Two main problems limit the availability of medicines today.
mandarin: 如今，药品之所以难以获得，主要是拜两大问题所赐。

english: One is that they are very costly; or, more accurately, the price charged for them is very high, though the cost of producing them is but a fraction of that amount.
mandarin: 其中之一是药品成本太高；或者，更正确地说，是药品要价太高，而生产成本只是要价的一小部分。

english: Second, drug development is geared toward maximizing profit, not social benefit, which skews efforts directed at the creation of medicines that are essential to human welfare.
mandarin: 第二个问题是药品开发的着眼点是利润最大化，而不是社会效益最大化，这使得药品开发倾向于创造对人类福利至关重要的品种。

english: Because the poor have so little money to spend, drug companies, under current arrangements, have little incentive to do research on the diseases that afflict them.
mandarin: 而穷人根本没有多少钱可花，因此，在现有安排下，制药公司根本没什么激励研究折磨穷人的疾病。

english: It doesn’t have to be this way.
mandarin: 事情本不必如此。

english: Drug companies argue that high prices are necessary to fund research and development.
mandarin: 制药公司指出，要价高是必要的，这是为了给研发提供资金。

english: But, in the United States, it is actually the government that finances most health-related research and development – directly, through public support (National Institutes of Health, National Science Foundation), and indirectly, through public purchases of medicine, both in the Medicare and Medicaid programs.
mandarin: 但是，在美国，大部分卫生相关研发活动的实际出资者是政府 — — 或是通过公共支持（美国国家卫生研究院、国家科学基金会等）直接提供资金，或是通过药品公共采购（如医疗保险和医疗补助计划）间接提供资金。

english: Even the part that is not government-financed is not a conventional market; most individuals’ purchases of prescription medicines are covered by insurance.
mandarin: 不能获得政府融资的部分也不是传统市场；许多个人的处方药支出都能获得保险赔付。

english: Government finances health-care research because improved medicines are a public good.
mandarin: 政府之所以为卫生研究提供融资，是因为改善药品是一种公共品。

english: The resulting knowledge benefits everyone by stopping epidemics and limiting the economic and human toll of widespread illness.
mandarin: 由此带来的知识进步能防止传染病、减轻常见病的经济和人身伤害，从而让每个人都受益。

english: Efficiency requires sharing research as widely as possible as soon as it is available.
mandarin: 要获得高效，就必须在获得知识进步后尽可能快地共享之。

english: Thomas Jefferson compared knowledge to candles: when one is used to light another, it does not diminish the light of the first.
mandarin: 托马斯·杰斐逊曾将知识比作蜡烛：用一根蜡烛点燃另一根蜡烛，并不会减弱前一根蜡烛的光辉。

english: On the contrary, everything becomes brighter.
mandarin: 相反，这样能使所有东西都变得更亮。

english: Yet, in America and most of the world, drug prices are still exorbitant and the spread of knowledge is tightly limited.
mandarin: 但是，在美国以及世界大部分地区，药品价格依然高得离谱，知识的传播则受到了严格的制约。

english: That is because we have created a patent system that gives innovators a temporary monopoly over what they create, which encourages them to hoard their knowledge, lest they help a competitor.
mandarin: 这是因为我们所创造的专利制度给了创新者对其所创之物的暂时垄断权，这促使创新者对知识敝帚自珍，唯恐助了竞争者一臂之力。

english: While this system does provide incentives for certain kinds of research by making innovation profitable, it allows drug companies to drive up prices, and the incentives do not necessarily correspond to social returns.
mandarin: 这一制度使得创新有利可图，从而确实为某些类型的研究提供了激励；但制药公司也因此得以坐地起价，它们获得的激励与社会回报不一定相容。

english: In the health-care sector, it may be more profitable to devote research to a “me-too” drug than to the development of a treatment that really makes a difference.
mandarin: 在卫生领域，致力于研究“仿造”药可能比开发一种另辟蹊径的疗法更加有利可图。

english: The patent system may even have adverse effects on innovation, because, while the most important input into any research is prior ideas, the patent system encourages secrecy.
mandarin: 专利制度甚至可能对创新起到反作用，因为研究的最重要输入变量是领先的思想，而专利制度却在鼓励彼此保密。

english: A solution to both high prices and misdirected research is to replace the current model with a government-supported prize fund.
mandarin: 要价高企和研究��向偏差问题的解决之道是用政府奖励基金代替现有模式。

english: With a prize system, innovators are rewarded for new knowledge, but they do not retain a monopoly on its use.
mandarin: 在奖励制度下，创新者将因新知识而受到奖赏，但不再获得新知识使用的垄断权。

english: That way, the power of competitive markets can ensure that, once a drug is developed, it is made available at the lowest possible price – not at an inflated monopoly price.
mandarin: 这样一来，竞争性市场的力量将能保证只要药品被开发出来，就能以尽可能低的价格（而不是大大膨胀的垄断价）为患者所获。

english: Fortunately, some US lawmakers are taking a strong interest in this approach.
mandarin: 幸运的是，一些美国立法者已对这一方法产生了浓厚兴趣。

english: The Prize Fund for HIV/AIDS Act, a congressional bill introduced by Senator Bernie Sanders, is just such an initiative.
mandarin: 参议员桑德斯（Bernie Sanders）提出、并获得国会通过的艾滋病奖励基金法（Prize Fund for HIV/AIDS Act）只是一个开始。

english: His bill also contains an important provision aimed at encouraging open-source research, which would move the current research model away from secrecy toward sharing.
mandarin: 桑德斯的法案包括了一个旨在鼓励开源研究的重要部分，将促使现有研究模式从保密转向共享。

english: But, globally, our innovation system needs much bigger changes.
mandarin: 但是，从全球角度看，我们的创新制度还需要做出大得多的变化。

english: The WHO’s efforts to encourage broad reforms at the international level are crucial.
mandarin: 世界卫生组织旨在促进国际层面的广泛改革的努力非常关键。

english: This spring, the WHO released a report that recommends solutions similar to those proposed in the US Senate bill, but on a global level.
mandarin: 今年春天，世界卫生组织公布了一份报告，其中提出了一项类似于桑德斯法案的解决之道 — — 只不过世卫组织的方案是全球水平的。

english: Importantly, the report, “Research and Development to Meet Health Needs in Developing Countries,” recommends a comprehensive approach, including mandatory funding contributions from governments for research on developing countries’ health needs; international coordination of health-care priorities and implementation; and a global observatory that would monitor where needs are greatest.
mandarin: 有一点很重要，这份题为《用研发满足发展中国家的卫生需要 》 （ “Research and Development to Meet Health Needs in Developing Countries）给出了一个完整的方法，包括来自政府的指令性发展中国家卫生研究资金分配；优先卫生项目和实施的国际合作；以及监测最紧迫需求的全球观察组。

english: In late May, the international community will have a chance to begin implementing these ideas at the WHO World Health Assembly – a moment of hope for public health around the world.
mandarin: 5月底，国际社会将由机会在世界卫生组织大会上开始实施这些想法，这将是世界公共卫生的希望时刻。

english: Reforming our innovation system is not just a matter of economics.
mandarin: 改革创新制度并不仅仅是一个经济问题。

english: It is, in many cases, a matter of life and death.
mandarin: 在很多情况下，它是个事关生死的大问题。

english: It is therefore essential to de-link R&D incentives from drug prices, and to promote greater sharing of scientific knowledge.
mandarin: 因此，将研发激励与药品价格脱钩、鼓励更多的科学知识分享至关重要。

english: For America, the Sanders bill marks important progress.
mandarin: 对美国来说，桑德斯法案是一次重大进步。

english: For the world, the WHO’s recommendations represent a once-in-a-generation opportunity to remedy a long-standing and egregious inequity in health care, and, more broadly, to set a model for governance of global public goods befitting an era of globalization.
mandarin: 对全世界来说，世卫组织的建议可谓修正长期存在的卫生不平等性恶疾的千载难逢的良机（从更广的角度讲，也是设立与全球化时代相适应的全球公共品治理新模式的良机 ） 。

english: We cannot afford to let this opportunity pass us by.
mandarin: 我们决不能坐视这个机会从手中白白溜走。

english: India’s Change of Guard
mandarin: 印度换防

english: SINGAPORE – In August, Raghuram Rajan was appointed Governor of the Reserve Bank of India.
mandarin: 新加坡—8月，拉古兰·拉詹（Raghuram Rajan）被任命为印度储备银行行长。

english: On one level, this was a routine announcement that many had anticipated – after all, Rajan is arguably the best-known Indian economist of his generation.
mandarin: 从某种程度上讲，这是很多人意料之中的宣布 — — 毕竟，拉詹被认为是这一代最著名的印度经济学家。

english: On another level, however, his appointment can be seen as part of a broader generational shift.
mandarin: 但是，从另一个层面讲，他的任命可以视为更广泛的代际变化的一部分。

english: Rajan, just 50, will be the first RBI governor born after India became a republic in 1950.
mandarin: 年仅50岁的拉詹将是第一位出生于1950年印度成为共和国之后的央行行长。

english: Similar changes are taking place in all walks of Indian life, including politics, the arts, sports, and social development.
mandarin: 印度社会各界都在发生类似的变化，包括政治、艺术、体育和社会发展等领域。

english: And India will be better for it.
mandarin: 印度也将因此受益。

english: Although the country is one of the youngest in the world, with an average age of just 26 years, until recently aging stalwarts incongruously dominated most fields, from politics to the arts and even business and sports.
mandarin: 尽管印度是世界上最年轻的国家之一，国民平均年龄只有26岁，但直到最近，在各行各业占据主导地位的无不是一些高龄老顽固，从政治到艺术甚至商业和体育诸领域都是如此。

english: But now younger entrants are rising everywhere, bringing with them energy and new ideas.
mandarin: 但年轻后生在各个领域全面崛起，带来了新能量和新思维。

english: In politics, as the country prepares for next year’s general election, the leading contenders to replace 81-year-old Prime Minister Manmohan Singh are the Bharatiya Janata Party’s Narendra Modi, 62, and Rahul Gandhi, who is just 43.
mandarin: 在政治界，明年大选即将到来之际，取代81岁的现任总理辛格的最有力候选人是来自印度人民党的62岁的莫迪（Narendra Modi）和年仅43岁的甘地（Rahul Gandhi ） 。

english: Either man would be the first prime minister who was not born in the British Raj.
mandarin: 不管谁当选，都将是第一位告别英属印度时代后出生的总理。

english: The arts were one of the first areas to witness this generational change.
mandarin: 艺术界是第一个发生这一代际变化的领域之一。

english: For a long time, Indian literature, especially in English, was dominated by a clique who wrote mainly for a niche audience and literary recognition.
mandarin: 长期以来，在印度文学界，特别是英语文学界，占主导地位的一直是主要为一小撮读者和文学界的认可而写作的作家。

english: Then, a few years ago, a group of young writers – such as Chetan Bhagat and Amish Tripathi, both former bankers – changed the rules of the game by writing for the mass market.
mandarin: 但是，几年前，一群青年作家 — — 如Chetan Bhagat和Amish Tripathi，两人此前都是银行家 — — 通过为大众写作改变了游戏规则。

english: Rather than write for literary critics, they began to use a simpler language, including Indian turns of phrase.
mandarin: 他们不再为文学批评而写作，而是开始用更简单的语言，包括印度土话。

english: They also chose new themes: Tripathi dipped into ancient mythology to write a trilogy about the god Shiva, while Bhagat began to write about the lives of India’s young, upwardly mobile middle class.
mandarin: 他们还选择了新的写作主题：Tripathi挖掘古神话题材，写出了关于湿婆神的三部曲；Bhagat开始写印度年青一代、向上奋斗的中产阶级的生活。

english: Predictably, the purists pounced and the critics ridiculed.
mandarin: 不难预测，这引起了纯粹主义者的强烈反弹和批评家的嘲讽。

english: But people have bought their books in the millions, and film deals have followed.
mandarin: 但人民买他们的账，他们的书销量以百万计，并被改编成了电影。

english: As a result, the market for books has dramatically expanded and publishers have been forced to change their entire business strategies.
mandarin: 结果，图书市场出现了井喷，出版商被迫改变整个商业战略。

english: Something similar has happened in the music industry. Previously dominated by a small cabal of singers and music directors, the market has been transformed by TV talent contests, similar to American Idol, which provide a national showcase for the wealth of India’s talent.
mandarin: 音乐产业也是如此，此前被一小撮歌手和音乐指导主宰的市场被电视选秀节目所改变，这些类似《美国偶像》的节目为年轻音乐天才提供了全国性的舞台。

english: The shows have made participants, some drawn from remote towns, into overnight stars, and many of them have gone on to sign lucrative careers.
mandarin: 选秀节目为参与者 — — 其中不少来自偏远城镇 — — 提供了一夜成名的机会，许多人因此获得了令人羡慕的职业机会。

english: Thanks partly to this parade of new talent, the Indian music industry is experiencing a period of extraordinary innovation and expansion.
mandarin: 部分归因于对这种形式的新人才检阅，印度音乐产业步入了超乎寻常的创新和扩张期。

english: The output of the US and European music industries sounds stale in comparison, owing to a dearth of innovation over the last two decades.
mandarin: 相比之下，美国欧洲音乐产业的产出立刻显得相形见绌，这是因为后两者在过去二十年里鲜有创新。

english: Generational change has even come to India’s most popular sport – cricket.
mandarin: 代际变化甚至出现在印度最受欢迎的体育项目 — — 板球上。

english: Such was the adulation once heaped upon its aging stars that many of them remained on the national team long past their peak.
mandarin: 曾几何时，这项运动的所有光荣都集中在高龄球星上，以至于他们中很多人早已过了巅峰期但仍占据着国家队名额。

english: But a mere two years after winning the World Cup in 2011, several members of that victorious team have been replaced – a decision that until recently would have seemed unthinkable.
mandarin: 但在2011年夺得世界杯仅仅两年后，这支胜利之师中的几名队员就已经换了人 — — 在不久前，这还是令人不可思议的现象。

english: India’s social sector has also been transformed.
mandarin: 印度社会也在发生变化。

english: Development policy used to be dominated by career activists wedded to socialist-era thinking.
mandarin: 发展政策曾经被浸淫社会主义时期思想的职业活动家主导。

english: But the arrival of new faces from the world of business, such as Ashish Dhawan, Jayant Sinha, and Ramesh and Swati Ramanathan, has meant that development issues are at last being assessed according to the problem-solving approach of social entrepreneurs, rather than through the ideological lens of activists.
mandarin: 但来自商界的新面孔 — — 比如Ashish Dhawan、Jayant Sinha和Ramesh和Swati Ramanathan — — 意味着发展问题至少会由社会创业家的问题解决思路评估，而不是通过活跃分子的意识形态来决定。

english: Ironically, it is the world of business that remains slow to change.
mandarin: 讽刺的是，变化缓慢的正是商界。

english: The growth of the IT sector in the 1990’s seemed to promise that change would be rapid and far-reaching, but the old business families still dominate.
mandarin: 1990年代IT部门的增长似乎预示着变化会是快速且影响深远的，但商业就家族依然拥有主宰地位。

english: There is hope, though.
mandarin: 但希望仍在。

english: Entrepreneurs like Manish Sabharwal of Teamlease, and Binny and Sachin Bansal of Flipkart, an online retailer, are fundamentally changing the way India does business.
mandarin: 像Teamlease公司的Manish Sabharwal和在线零售商Flipkart公司的Binny和Sachin Bansal这样的创业家在从根本改变印度的商业模式。

english: Similarly, Indian academia may be moribund, but new public intellectuals like Pratap Bhanu Mehta have emerged from outside the mainstream.
mandarin: 类似地，印度学界或许也处于停滞不前的状态，但新Pratap Bhanu Mehta等公共知识分子正在崛起于主流之外。

english: Yes, India’s economy has slowed sharply, the rupee has plunged, and scandals and protests dominate the headlines.
mandarin: 是的，印度经济出现了急剧放缓，卢比出现了大幅贬值，新闻标题充斥着丑闻和示威游行。

english: But, behind the gloom, a new generation is taking over, bringing with it fresh ideas and visions for India.
mandarin: 但是，在乌云背后，新一代正在接棒，给印度带来新的思想和前途。

english: As a species, human beings have a major self-control problem.
mandarin: 作为一个物种，人类存在很大的自我控制问题。

english: We humans are now so aggressively fishing, hunting, logging, and growing crops in all parts of the world that we are literally chasing other species off the planet.
mandarin: 我们人类现在全世界所有的地方如此大肆捕鱼、打猎、采伐和种植作物，乃至我们实际上在把其他物种从地球上驱赶出去。

english: Our intense desire to take all that we can from nature leaves precious little for other forms of life.
mandarin: 我们极度想要从大自然中索取所有我们可以索取的东西，留给其他生物种类的东西少之又少。

english: In 1992, when the world’s governments first promised to address man-made global warming, they also vowed to head off the human-induced extinction of other species.
mandarin: 在1992年世界各国政府第一次保证解决人为全球气候变暖的时候，他们同时还誓言阻止由人类引发的其他物种的灭绝。

english: The Convention on Biological Diversity, agreed at the Rio Earth Summit, established that “biological diversity is a common concern of humanity.”
mandarin: 在里约热内卢通过的生物多样性公约确认“生物多样性是人类的共同关切问题。

english: The signatories agreed to conserve biological diversity, by saving species and their habitats, and to use biological resources (e.g., forests) in a sustainable manner.
mandarin: ”签署国们同意通过挽救物种及其栖息地来保全生物多样性，并且以可持续的方式使用生物资源(例如森林 ) 。

english: In 2002, the treaty’s signatories went further, committing to “a significant reduction in the current rate of biodiversity loss” by 2010.
mandarin: 2002年，该公约的签署国们更进一步，承诺在2010年以前“大幅度削减目前的生物多样性损失 ” 。

english: Unfortunately, like so many other international agreements, the Convention on Biological Diversity remains essentially unknown, un-championed, and unfulfilled.
mandarin: 不幸的是，就像其他如此众多的国际公约一样，生物多样性公约基本上不为人所知，没有得到宣传促进，也没有得到落实。

english: That neglect is a human tragedy.
mandarin: 这一疏忽是人类的悲剧。

english: For a very low cash outlay – and perhaps none at all on balance – we could conserve nature and thus protect the basis of our own lives and livelihoods.
mandarin: 只需要很少的现金投入，甚至在根本上不需要花钱，我们就本能够保全自然，并且进而保护人类自身生命和生计的基础。

english: We kill other species not because we must, but because we are too negligent to do otherwise.
mandarin: 我们并非是出于必须才杀戮其他物种，而是我们过于疏忽，乃至不改弦更张。

english: Consider a couple of notorious examples.
mandarin: 让我们来看一看几个臭名昭著的例子。

english: Some rich countries, such as Spain, Portugal, Australia, and New Zealand, have fishing fleets that engage in so-called “bottom trawling.”
mandarin: 像西班牙、葡萄牙、澳大利亚以及新西兰等富国拥有从事所谓“水底拖网”的捕鱼船队。

english: Bottom trawlers drag heavy nets over the ocean bottom, destroying magnificent, unexplored, and endangered marine species in the process.
mandarin: 水底拖网在海洋底部拖走很重的鱼网，从而在这一过程中摧毁大量没有探明并且受到威胁的海洋物种。

english: Complex and unique ecologies, most notably underground volcanoes known as seamounts, are ripped to shreds, because bottom trawling is the “low cost” way to catch a few deep sea fish species.
mandarin: 因为水底拖网是捕捞某些深海鱼种的“低成本”办法，因此某些复杂而又独特的生态、最为主要的是被称为海底山的地下火山被切断。

english: One of these species, orange roughy, has been caught commercially for only around a quarter-century, but already is being fished to the point of collapse.
mandarin: 其中的一个物种叫做橙连鳍鲑，被用于商业捕捞不过大约25年的时间，但是已经被捕捞得处于崩溃的边缘。

english: Likewise, in many parts of the world, tropical rainforest is being cleared for pasture land and food crops.
mandarin: 同样在世界许多地方，热带雨林遭到砍伐来开辟牧场和粮食作物。

english: The result is massive loss of habitat and destruction of species, yielding a tiny economic benefit at a huge social cost.
mandarin: 结果就是栖息地的大量损失和物种的毁灭，所产生的微小的经济利益是以巨大的社会成本为代价的。

english: After cutting down a swath of rainforest, soils are often quickly leached of their nutrients so that they cannot sustain crops or nutritious grasses for livestock.
mandarin: 在一片雨林被砍伐后，土壤通常马上就丧失了养分， 无法供养作物或者让家畜食用有营养的草地。

english: As a result, the new pasture land or farmland is soon abandoned, with no prospect for regeneration of the original forest and its unique ecosystems.
mandarin: 结果，新的牧场或农田马上被放弃，没有机会再退耕还林，恢复其独特的生态系统。

english: Because these activities’ costs are so high and their benefits so low, stopping them would be easy.
mandarin: 由于这些活动的代价高昂、收益低下，停止这些活动是容易的。

english: Bottom trawling should simply be outlawed; it would be simple and inexpensive to compensate the fishing industry during a transition to other activities.
mandarin: 水底拖网应当干脆被取缔；在捕鱼产业向其他活动转型期间予以补偿是容易做到而且也是费用不大的。

english: Forest clearing, on the other hand, is probably best stopped by economic incentives, perhaps combined with regulatory limits.
mandarin: 另一方面，砍伐森林最好通过经济激励的方式辅之以管治限制予以制止。

english: Simply restricting the practice of land clearing probably would not work, since farm families and communities would face a strong temptation to evade legal limits.
mandarin: 简单地限制开发土地的做法可能无法奏效，因为农业家庭和社区将会面临极大的躲避法律限制的诱惑。

english: On the other hand, financial incentives would probably succeed, because cutting down forest to create pastureland is not profitable enough to induce farmers to forego payments for protecting the land.
mandarin: 在另一方面，财政刺激可能会成功，因为砍伐森林来创造牧场土地并不有利可图，从而使得农民为了保护土地而放弃付款。

english: Many rainforest countries have united in recent years to suggest the establishment of a rainforest conservation fund by the rich countries, to pay impoverished small farmers a small amount of money to preserve the forest.
mandarin: 许多雨林国家在最近几年中联合起来提议富有国家建立雨林储存基金，用来向贫困的小农场主支付少量金额来保护森林。

english: A well-designed fund would slow or stop deforestation, preserve biodiversity, and reduce emissions of carbon dioxide the burning of cleared forests.
mandarin: 一个设计合理的基金将会放缓或者停止森林采伐，保护生物多样性，并且减少燃烧砍伐后的森林所造成的二氧化碳排放。

english: At the same time, small farmers would receive a steady flow of income, which they could use for micro-investments to improve their household’s wealth, education, and health.
mandarin: 与此同时，小农场主将会得到稳定的收入，他们可以用这笔钱作小额投资用以改善家庭的财富、教育和健康。

english: Aside from banning bottom trawling and establishing a global fund for avoided deforestation, we should designate a global network of protected marine areas, in which fishing, boating, polluting, dredging, drilling, and other damaging activities would be prohibited.
mandarin: 除了取缔水底拖网并且建立为避免森林砍伐的全球性基金外，我们应当指定一个全球性的海洋保护区域网络，在这些区域中禁止捕鱼、划船、污染、挖泥、钻探以及其他有害的活动。

english: Such areas not only permit the regeneration of species, but also provide ecological benefits that spill over to neighboring unprotected areas.
mandarin: 这些区域不仅可以重新恢复物种，而且还可以提供生态效益向邻近的未保护区域扩散。

english: We also need a regular scientific process to present the world with the evidence on species abundance and extinction, just as we now have such a process for climate change.
mandarin: 我们还需要定期的科学进程来向世界展示物种繁荣和灭绝的证据，正如有关气候变化的进程一样。

english: Politicians don’t listen very well to individual scientists, but they are forced to listen when hundreds of scientists speak with a united voice.
mandarin: 政客们并不十分听取个别科学家的意见，但是当几百个科学家异口同声的时候他们就不得不���取了。

english: Finally, the world should negotiate a new framework no later than 2010 to slow human-induced climate change.
mandarin: 最后，各国应该在不迟于2010年谈判一项新的框架来减缓人为引起的气候变化。

english: There can be little doubt that climate change poses one of the greatest risks to species’ viability.
mandarin: 毫无疑问，气候变化是物种生存最大的威胁之一。

english: As the planet warms, and rain and storm patterns change dramatically, many species will find themselves in climate zones that no longer support their survival.
mandarin: 当地球变暖、 降雨和风暴模式大幅度改变之际，许多物种都会处于不再支持其存活的气候区域内。

english: Some can migrate, but others (such as polar bears) are likely to be driven to extinction unless we take decisive action to head off climate change.
mandarin: 某些物种可以迁徙，但是，除非我们采取决定性的行动来阻止气候变化，其他的物种(例如北极熊)就有可能遭到灭绝。

english: These measures are achievable by 2010.
mandarin: 在2010年以前实现这些目标是可能的。

english: They are affordable, and in each case would ultimately deliver large net benefits.
mandarin: 它们在经济上是可以承担的，而且在各个情况下都最终会带来巨大的净效益。

english: Most importantly, they would allow us to follow through on a global promise.
mandarin: 最为重要的是，这将会让我们实现全球性的许诺。

english: It is too painful to believe that humanity would destroy millions of other species – and jeopardize our own future – in a fit of absent-mindedness.
mandarin: 人类在心不在焉之际会摧毁数以白万计的其他物种并威胁到我们自己的未来，要相信这一点是过于痛苦的。

english: Making Do With More
mandarin: 多劳应多得

english: BERKELEY – In the United States, just three out of ten workers are needed to produce and deliver the goods we consume.
mandarin: 伯克利—在美国，生产和递送我们所消费的商品只需要十分之三的工人。

english: Everything we extract, grow, design, build, make, engineer, and transport – down to brewing a cup of coffee in a restaurant kitchen and carrying it to a customer's table – is done by roughly 30% of the country's workforce.
mandarin: 我们提炼、种植、设计、建造、制作、打磨和运送的所有东西 — — 一直到从饭店厨房泡一杯咖啡并送给餐桌前的顾客 — — 是由大约30%的美国劳动力做的。

english: The rest of us spend our time planning what to make, deciding where to install the things we have made, performing personal services, talking to each other, and keeping track of what is being done, so that we can figure out what needs to be done next.
mandarin: 我们其他人把时间花在规划制造什么、决定把我们造出来的东西摆在哪里、履行个人服务、彼此谈话、追踪正在制造什么上，以便我们能够发现我们下一步需要做什么。

english: And yet, despite our obvious ability to produce much more than we need, we do not seem to be blessed with an embarrassment of riches.
mandarin: 而尽管我们显然拥有制造比我们需要的多得多的东西的能力，但我们似乎并不会富得发慌。

english: One of the great paradoxes of our time is that workers and middle-class households continue to struggle in a time of unparalleled plenty.
mandarin: 现时代的一大悖论正是工人和中产阶级家庭在前无古人的丰裕时代仍然要为生活奔波。

english: We in the developed countries have more than enough to cover our basic needs.
mandarin: 我们发达国家的人要想满足基本需要易如反掌。

english: We have enough organic carbon-hydrogen bonds to break to provide us with calories; enough vitamins and other nutrients to keep us healthy; enough shelter to keep us dry; enough clothing to keep us warm; enough capital to keep us, at least potentially, productive; and enough entertainment to keep us from being bored.
mandarin: 我们有的是有机碳氢键，打破它们就能 给我们带来卡路里；我们有的是维生素和其他营养物质帮助我们保持健康；我们有的是居所让我们保持干燥；我们有的是衣服让我们保持温暖；我们有的是资本让我们（至少潜在地）拥有生产力；我们有的是娱乐项目让我们不至于无聊。

english: And we produce all of it for an average of less than two hours a day of work outside the home.
mandarin: 我们生产所有这些，只需要平均每天花不到两小时走出家门去工作。

english: John Maynard Keynes was not off by much when he famously predicted in 1930 that the human race's “economic problem, the struggle for subsistence," was likely to be “solved, or be at least within sight of solution, within a hundred years."
mandarin: 1930年，当凯恩斯的著名预言预测人类的“经济问题，即生存斗争”有可能“在一百年内得到解决，或至少看到解决办法。

english: And yet there are few signs that working- and middle-class Americans are living any better than they did 35 years ago.
mandarin: 然而没有什么迹象表明美国工人和中产阶级比35年前生活得更好。

english: Even stranger, productivity growth does not seem to be soaring, as one would expect; in fact, it seems to be decelerating, according to research by John Fernald and Bing Wang, economists in the Economic Research Department of the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco.
mandarin: 更奇怪的是，生产率增长似乎没有如你预期的那样大幅加速；事实上，根据旧金山联邦储备银行经济研究部的约翰·费纳尔多（John Fernald）和王兵（音）的研究，生产率增长出现了减速。

english: Growth prospects are even worse, as innovation hits gale-force headwinds.
mandarin: 增长前景甚至更加糟糕，因为创新活动撞上了南墙。

english: One way to reconcile the changes in the job market with our lived experience and statistics like these is to note that much of what we are producing is very different from what we have made in the past.
mandarin: 一个协调就业市场变化与我们的生活经验和这些统计数字的办法是注意到我们生产的许多东西与我们过去所制造的东西区别很大。

english: For most of human experience, the bulk of what we produced could not be easily shared or used without permission.
mandarin: 在人类历史的大部分时间里，我们生产出来的东西无法轻易地在未经允许的情况下共享或使用。

english: The goods we made were what economists call “rival" and “excludible" commodities.
mandarin: 我们以前制造的东西是经济学家所谓的“竞争性”或“排他性”商品。

english: Being “rival" means that two people cannot use the same product at the same time.
mandarin: “竞争性”是指两个人无法在同时使用同一个产品。

english: Being “excludible" means that the owner of a product can easily prevent others from using it.
mandarin: “排他性”是指产品的所有者可以轻易地阻止其他人使用这个产品。

english: These two traits put a great deal of bargaining power in the hands of those who control production and distribution, making them ideal for a market economy based on private property.
mandarin: 这两个特征让控制生产和分配的人拥有了巨大的议价权，成为基于私人产权的市场经济的理想之选。

english: Money naturally flows to where utility and value are being provided – and those flows are easy to track in national accounts.
mandarin: 钱自然而然地流向了提供效用和价值的地方 — — 并且这些资金流可以轻易地在国民账户中进行追踪。

english: But much of what we are producing in the information age is neither rival nor excludible – and this changes the entire picture.
mandarin: 但我们在信息时代所生产的许多东西既不具有竞争性，也不具有排他性 — — 这改变了整个局面。

english: The creation of information-age goods is difficult to incentivize; their distribution is hard to monetize; and we lack the tools to track them easily in national accounts.
mandarin: 信息时代商品的制造很难施加激励；它们的分配也难以货币化；我们也缺乏工具在国民账户中轻易地追踪它们。

english: The result is an ever-growing discrepancy between what people would be willing to pay for a given service and growth as measured in national statistics.
mandarin: 结果是人们愿意为给定服务所支付的数量与国民统计所测量的增长之间的差异越来越大。

english: In other words, we are producing and consuming much more than our economic indicators suggest – and the creators of many of those products are not being adequately compensated.
mandarin: 换句话说，我们生产和消费的数量比经济指标所显示的规模大得多 — — 而许多这些产品的额制造者没有获得充分的报偿。

english: To ensure that the workers of today and tomorrow are able to capture the benefits of the information age will require us to redesign our economic system to stimulate the creation of these new types of commodities.
mandarin: 为了确保今天和明天的工人能够获得信息时代的好处，我们就必须重新设计经济制度以刺激这些新型商品的创造。

english: In addition to developing ways to account for this new type of wealth, we will have to develop channels through which demand for a product contributes to the income of its creator.
mandarin: 除了找到记录这一新型财富的方法，我们还需要找到将让产品需求有利于创造者收入的渠道。

english: Only by finding ways to put true value on the goods we produce will we be able to sustain a middle-class society, rather than one of techno-plutocrats and their service-sector serfs.
mandarin: 只有找到能准确衡量我们所制造的商品的额价值的方法，我们才能维持中产阶级社会，而不至于出现由技术大亨和他们的服务业农奴组成的社会。

english: CAMBRIDGE – Academic freedom is a precious commodity, critical to ensure that discovery of the truth is not encumbered by political or ideological forces.
mandarin: 剑桥 — — 学术自由是对确保政治或意识形态势力不阻碍真相发现起关键作用的一种珍贵的商品。

english: But this does not mean that intellectuals should hide in academic bunkers that, by protecting us from criticism by “non-experts,” allow ego to flourish and enable a focus on questions that are not actually relevant to anyone else.
mandarin: 但这并不意味着知识分子应当躲进学术掩体，在保护我们免受“非专家”责难的同时，允许自我意识迅速泛滥，允许自己关注对其他任何人都无关紧要的话题。

english: We experts should have to explain ourselves.
mandarin: 我们这些专家应当向外界解释我们自己。

english: This means, first and foremost, that researchers should be communicating their results in a way that supports accountability and confirms that public funds and education benefits are being used in ways that are in taxpayers’ interests.
mandarin: 首先这意味着研究人员应当以接受问责的方式向外界公开他们的研究成果，从而确保公共资金和教育福利的使用方式符合纳税人的利益。

english: The duty to communicate findings also ensures that the public is educated, not only about the topic itself, but also about the way research actually works.
mandarin: 公开研究成果的义务也确保公众能够受到教育，这不仅关系到课题本身，同时也关系到学术研究的实际运作方式。

english: Scholarly books and journals often give the impression that the truth is revealed through a neat, orderly, and logical process.
mandarin: 学术书籍和期刊往往给人留下这样的印象，那就是学术界通过整洁、有序而且合乎逻辑的方式来揭示真理。

english: But research is far from being a pristine landscape; in fact, it resembles a battlefield, littered with miscalculations, failed experiments, and discarded assumptions.
mandarin: 但科学研究远不是什么纯粹地带；事实上，它更像一个战场，充满了计算失误、试验失败和最终被丢弃的假设。

english: The path to truth is often convoluted, and those who travel along it often must navigate fierce competition and professional intrigue.
mandarin: 通往真理的道路往往迂回曲折，走在真理之路上的人们往往要经受激烈的竞争和专业阴谋。

english: Some argue that it is better to hide this reality from the public, in order to maintain credibility.
mandarin: 有人提出为保持公信力，最好隐藏这样的事实。

english: For example, in 2014, physicists collaborating on a project known as BICEP2 thought that they had detected gravitational waves from the beginning of the universe.
mandarin: 例如，2014年，合作参与BICEP2项目的物理学家以为已经探测到宇宙初期的引力波。

english: It was later realized that the signal they had detected could be entirely attributed to interstellar dust.
mandarin: 但后来他们逐渐意识到所探测到的信号可能完全来源于星际尘埃。

english: Some of my colleagues worried that this revelation would undermine faith in other scientific predictions, such as those involving climate change.
mandarin: 我的某些同事担心这个消息一旦泄露出去，会影响人们对气候变化等其他科学预测的信心。

english: But would hiding the truth from the public really do more for scientific and academic credibility than cultivating a culture of transparency?
mandarin: 但对公众隐瞒真相是否真的比创造透明文化更有利于科学和学术的可信性？

english: Probably not.
mandarin: 也许并非如此。

english: In fact, being honest about the realities of research might enhance trust and create more space for innovation, with an informed public accepting that risk is the unavoidable and worthwhile cost of groundbreaking and broadly beneficial discoveries.
mandarin: 事实上，对研究现状保持诚实可以增强信任感并创造更多创新空间，在这种情况下，理性的公众接受科研风险不可避免，科研上付出的代价能为取得开创性和普遍有益的科研成果做出自己的贡献。

english: Another way to ensure that academia continues to innovate in useful and relevant ways is to blur the traditional boundaries among disciplines – the frontiers where invention so often happens.
mandarin: 确保学术界继续相关有效创新的另外一种方式是打破学科之间的传统界限 — — 创新发现往往诞生在这些前沿领域。

english: To that end, universities should update their organizational structure, moving away from clearly delineated departments in order to create a kind of continuum across the arts, humanities, and sciences.
mandarin: 为了实现这一目标，大学应当升级其组织结构，避免明确划定院系界限，以创造一种跨艺术、科学、人文的连续统一体。

english: Students should be encouraged to take courses in multiple disciplines, so that they can weave those lessons and experiences into new patterns of knowledge.
mandarin: 大学应鼓励学生学习多学科课程，以便他们能将经验和教训融入新的知识体系。

english: To make this process sustainable, universities should ensure that the courses and curricula they offer help students to develop the skills that a fast-changing labor market demands.
mandarin: 为使过程更具可持续性，大学应当确保所开设的课程能帮学生学到适应劳动力市场需求快速变化的新技术。

english: This means not just creating new curricula today, but also updating them every few years, in order to account for new trends and discoveries in areas ranging from artificial intelligence and Big Data to alternative energy sources and genome editing.
mandarin: 这意味着不仅现在要开设创新课程，而且要每隔几年更新一次，以便纳入从人工智能、大数据到替代能源和基因编辑领域的新发现和新趋势。

english: Professors, for their part, should approach their job as mentors of future leaders in science, technology, the arts, and humanities, rather than attempting to mold students in their own intellectual image.
mandarin: 对于教授们而言，他们应当成为科学、技术、艺术和人文等领域未来领袖的指导者，而不是试图让学生继承自己的学术衣钵。

english: Of course, the latter approach can be useful if the goal is to advance the popularity of one’s own research program and to ensure that one’s own ideas and perspective endure.
mandarin: 当然，如果目标是提高自身研究项目的普及度以及确保自身理念和观点能延续下去，后一种方法可能是有效的。

english: But that is not the fundamental mission of academia.
mandarin: 但这却与学术界的基本使命不符。

english: The louder the consensus in the echo chambers of academia become, the greater the ego boost for those who inhabit those chambers.
mandarin: 学术界面对相关共识的回声越响亮，就越能激发那些成果持有者的自我意识。

english: But history shows that progress is sometimes advocated by a soft voice in the background, like that of Albert Einstein during his early career.
mandarin: 但历史显示像阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦的早期职业生涯一样，有时柔和的背景声更能推动进步。

english: Truth and consensus are not always the same.
mandarin: 真相和共识并不总是一回事。

english: Diversity of opinion – which implies diversity of gender, ethnicity, and background – is vital to support creativity, discovery, and progress.
mandarin: 见解的多样性 — — 意味着性别、种族和背景的多样性 — — 对支持创新发展和进步起到关键的作用。

english: That is why it is so important for prizes and professional associations to be used not to reinforce mainstream perspectives, but rather to encourage independent thought and reward innovation.
mandarin: 这也解释了为什么不能用奖项和专业协会来强化主流观点，反而要用它们来鼓励独立思考和奖励创新的原因。

english: This does not mean that all opinions should be considered equal, but rather that alternative views should be debated and vetted on merit alone.
mandarin: 但这并不意味着所有见解都应视为平等，而意味着应当探讨其他观点，并以价值作为审核的唯一依据。

english: We in academia cannot continue to pat ourselves on the back, celebrating our own privileges and failing to look at the world in new and relevant ways.
mandarin: 我们学术界不能再继续宠溺自己，忙于庆幸自己的特权而不能以新的相关方式看待这个世界。

english: If we are to defend the freedom of our enterprise, we must restore dialogue with the broader public and ensure that the relevance of our work is well understood – including by us.
mandarin: 如果要捍卫创新自由，我们必须恢复与广大公众进行对话，并确保所有人充分理解我们工作的相关性 — — 这其中也包括我们自身。

english: The Closing of the Academic Mind
mandarin: 学术精神的落幕

english: LONDON – I would wager that I have been Chancellor of more universities than anyone alive today.
mandarin: 伦敦 — — 我敢打赌我比现在活着的人当过更多所大学的校长。

english: This is partly because when I was Governor of Hong Kong, I was made Chancellor of every university in the city.
mandarin: 这部分因为在担任香港总督期间，我被任命为这座城市所有大学的校长。

english: I protested that it would surely be better for the universities to choose their own constitutional heads.
mandarin: 我抗议说应当让大学自主选择行政领导。

english: But the universities would not allow me to resign gracefully.
mandarin: 但大学却不允许我轻易辞职。

english: So for five years I enjoyed the experience of giving tens of thousands of students their degrees and watching what this rite of passage meant for them and their families.
mandarin: 因此有5年时间，我享受着为数以万计学子授予学位的体验，并亲眼目睹了这样的仪式对学子和他们的家庭意味着什么。

english: When I came back to Britain in 1997, I was asked to become Chancellor of Newcastle University.
mandarin: 1997年回到英国时，我被任命为纽卡斯尔大学的校长。

english: Then, in 2003, I was elected Chancellor by the graduates of Oxford University, one of the world’s greatest institutions of learning.
mandarin: 之后在2003年，我再次被毕业生推选为世界最伟大的学府之一，牛津大学的校长。

english: So it should not be surprising that I have strong views about what it means to be a university and to teach, do research, or study at one.
mandarin: 因此我对大学意味着什么、以及对校内教学、研究或学习有着强烈的观点也就不足为奇了。

english: Universities should be bastions of freedom in any society.
mandarin: 大学应当是一切社会的自由堡垒。

english: They should be free from government interference in their primary purposes of research and teaching; and they should control their own academic governance.
mandarin: 它们主要的研究和教学功能不应受到政府的干涉；它们应当能够控制自身的学术治理举措。

english: I do not believe it is possible for a university to become or remain a world-class institution if these conditions do not exist.
mandarin: 如果上述条件得不到满足，我不相信一所学校能够成为一所世界级的学府。

english: The role of a university is to promote the clash of ideas, to test the results of research with other scholars, and to impart new knowledge to students.
mandarin: 大学的功能是制造思想碰撞，与其他学者一道检验研究成果，以及对学生传授新的知识。

english: Freedom of speech is thus fundamental to what universities are, enabling them to sustain a sense of common humanity and uphold the mutual tolerance and understanding that underpin any free society.
mandarin: 言论自由因此对大学而言至关重要，它能让学者保持人类共同情感，并捍卫支撑任何自由社会的共同的理解和宽容。

english: That, of course, makes universities dangerous to authoritarian governments, which seek to stifle the ability to raise and attempt to answer difficult questions.
mandarin: 这当然导致独裁政府将大学视为危险，并试图遏制大学对疑难问题的提出和解答。

english: But if any denial of academic liberty is a blow struck against the meaning of a university, the irony today is that some of the most worrying attacks on these values have been coming from inside universities.
mandarin: 但如果任何否定学术自由的行为都是对大学意义的打击，那么今天最具有讽刺意义的却是某些对这些价值最令人担忧的攻击来源于大学内部。

english: In the United States and the United Kingdom, some students and teachers now seek to constrain argument and debate.
mandarin: 在美国和英国，某些学生和老师现在试图限制争鸣和辩论。

english: They contend that people should not be exposed to ideas with which they strongly disagree.
mandarin: 他们争辩说人们根本不应该听到他们强烈反对的想法。

english: Moreover, they argue that history should be rewritten to expunge the names (though not the endowments) of those who fail to pass today’s tests of political correctness.
mandarin: 此外，他们还提出应当将未能通过今天政治正确性测试者的名字（虽非才能）从历史上抹去。

english: Thomas Jefferson and Cecil Rhodes, among others, have been targeted.
mandarin: 托马斯·杰斐逊和塞西尔·罗兹就包括在这些名字当中。

english: And how would Churchill and Washington fare if the same tests were applied to them?
mandarin: 如果对丘吉尔和华盛顿进行同样的测试，他们的成绩将会如何？

english: Some people are being denied the chance to speak as well – so-called “no platforming”, in the awful jargon of some clearly not very literate campuses.
mandarin: 在某些显然不太有文化的校园常见的可怕行话（所谓的“无平台化 ” ） 里，某些人说话的机会被彻底剥夺。

english: There are calls for “safe spaces” where students can be protected from anything that assaults their sense of what is moral and appropriate.
mandarin: 有些人呼吁建立安全空间，确保违反“道德”和“恰当”认知的任何行为都不会被学生接触到。

english: This reflects and inevitably nurtures a harmful politics of victimization – defining one’s own identity (and thus one’s interests) in opposition to others.
mandarin: 这反应并必将孕育一种有害的牺牲政治 — — 即划定与别人相对立的自我身份（和自我利益 ） 。

english: When I was a student 50 years ago, my principal teacher was a leading Marxist historian and former member of the Communist Party.
mandarin: 50年前当我还是学生时，我主要的老师是一位著名的马克思主义历史学家兼前共产党。

english: The British security services were deeply suspicious of him.
mandarin: 英国安全部门非常怀疑他。

english: He was a great historian and teacher, but these days I might be encouraged to think that he had threatened my “safe space.”
mandarin: 他是一位伟大的历史学家和教师，但现在我却可能在外界鼓励下认为我的“安全空间”被他侵犯了。

english: In fact, he made me a great deal better informed, more open to discussion of ideas that challenged my own, more capable of distinguishing between an argument and a quarrel, and more prepared to think for myself.
mandarin: 事实上，他在很大程度上拓宽了我的视野，让我以开放的态度面对挑战自己想法的讨论，更有能力区分辩论和争吵，也更能独立思考事情的对错。

english: Of course, some ideas – incitement of racial hatred, gender hostility, or political violence – are anathema in every free society.
mandarin: 当然种族仇恨、性别敌意或政治暴力煽动等某些想法在任何一个自由社会都是被深恶痛绝的。

english: Liberty requires some limits (decided freely by democratic argument under the rule of law) in order to exist.
mandarin: 自由的存在需要（在法治条件下由民主辩论自由决定的）某种限度。

english: Universities should be trusted to exercise that degree of control themselves.
mandarin: 应当相信大学有能力加以自控。

english: But intolerance of debate, of discussion, and of particular branches of scholarship should never be tolerated.
mandarin: 但不容许辩论、探讨和特定学术领域的存在是永远不能被容忍的。

english: As the great political philosopher Karl Popper taught us, the only thing we should be intolerant of is intolerance itself.
mandarin: 正如伟大的政治哲学家卡尔·波普教导我们的那样，我们唯一不能容忍的特质应当是偏狭。

english: That is especially true at universities.
mandarin: 尤其在大学里更应当这样。

english: Yet some American and British academics and students are themselves undermining freedom; paradoxically, they have the liberty to do so.
mandarin: 而某些美国和英国的学者和学生本身就在破坏自由；荒谬的是，他们有自由这样做。

english: Meanwhile, universities in China and Hong Kong are faced with threats to their autonomy and freedom, not from within, but from an authoritarian government.
mandarin: 此外，中国和香港大学的自主权和自由正面临威胁，这些威胁并非来自于学校内部，而是来自于独裁政府。

english: In Hong Kong, the autonomy of universities and free speech itself, guaranteed in the city’s Basic Law and the 50-year treaty between Britain and China on the city’s status, are under threat.
mandarin: 在香港，城市基本法和中英50年条约共同规定的大学自主权及言论自由本身正在遭受威胁。

english: The rationale seems to be that, because students strongly supported the pro-democracy protests in 2014, the universities where they study should be brought to heel.
mandarin: 理由似乎是因为学生强烈支持2014年的民主抗议活动，他们所就读的大学应当受到惩罚。

english: So the city’s government blunders away, stirring up trouble, clearly on the orders of the government in Beijing.
mandarin: 于是香港政府匆匆忙忙地挑起事端，显然是在北京政府的命令之下。

english: Indeed, the Chinese authorities only recently showed what they think of treaty obligations and of the “golden age” of Sino-British relations (much advertised by British ministers), by abducting a British citizen (and four other Hong Kong residents) on the city’s streets.
mandarin: 事实上，通过在香港大街上绑架一名英国公民（和其他四名香港居民）的行为，中国政府最近才向外界表明他们对中英关系“黄金年代”条约义务（受到英国大臣们广为宣传）的看法。

english: The five were publishing books that exposed some of the dirty secrets of China’s leaders.
mandarin: 这5人出版的书籍揭露了中国领导人某些不可见人的秘密。

english: On the mainland, the Chinese Communist Party has launched the biggest crackdown on universities since the aftermath of the killings in Tiananmen Square in 1989.
mandarin: 在大陆，中国共产党对大学发动了继1989年天安门广场屠杀事件后最大规模的镇压。

english: There is to be no discussion of so-called Western values in China’s universities. Only Marxism can be taught.
mandarin: 中国大学不允许讨论所谓西方价值观，只允许教授马克思主义。

english: Did no one tell President Xi Jinping and his Politburo colleagues where Karl Marx came from?
mandarin: 难道没有人告诉习近平主席及其政治局同事卡尔·马克思从哪里来？

english: The trouble these days is precisely that they know little about Marx but a lot about Lenin.
mandarin: 现在的问题恰恰是他们对马克思知之甚少，但却对列宁了解颇多。

english: Westerners should take a closer interest in what is happening in China’s universities and what that tells us about the real values underpinning scholarship, teaching, and the academy.
mandarin: 西方人应密切关注中国大学正在发生的事件，以及它们对支撑学术、教学和学院的实际价值是什么？

english: Compare and contrast, as students are asked to do.
mandarin: 我们要学会像学生那样进行对比和比较。

english: Do you want universities where the government decides what it is allegedly safe for you to learn and discuss?
mandarin: 由政府决定什么能安全学习和探讨的大学是否符合你的愿望？

english: Or do you want universities that regard the idea of a “safe space” – in terms of closing down debate in case it offends someone – as an oxymoron in an academic setting?
mandarin: 你心目中的大学是否将“安全空间”理念 — — 即在冒犯他人的情况下停止讨论 — — 视为学术环境中的矛盾修饰法？

english: Western students should think occasionally about their counterparts in Hong Kong and China who must fight for freedoms that they take for granted – and too often abuse.
mandarin: 西方学生应时时想起他们在香港和中国的同伴，这些人仍在争取他们所熟视无睹 — — 甚至往往随意滥用的自由。

english: The New Brain Drain in Science
mandarin: 科研领域新一轮人才流失

english: DUBAI – In December 2013, the Nobel laureate physicist Peter Higgs told The Guardian that if he were seeking a job in academia today, “I don’t think I would be regarded as productive enough.”
mandarin: 迪拜 — — 2013年12月，诺贝尔物理学奖得主彼得·希格斯在接受卫报采访时表示，如果他今天在学术界求职 ， “ 我恐怕不会被认为是最高效的。

english: Having published fewer than ten papers since his groundbreaking work in 1964, Higgs believes that no university would employ him nowadays.
mandarin: ”因为在1964年发表突破之作后迄今为止仅发表过不到十篇论文，希格斯认为今天没有哪家大学会雇佣他。

english: Academics are well acquainted with the notion of “publish or perish.”
mandarin: “出版或者毁灭”是当今学者熟悉的概念。

english: They must publish their work in peer-reviewed journals increasingly often to climb the career ladder, protect their jobs, and secure funding for their institutions.
mandarin: 他们必须越来越多地在同行评议杂志上发表作品，才能攀登职业阶梯、保住工作岗位和为所在机构争取研究经费。

english: But what happens to scientists and other scholars, such as those in the Middle East, who have different research concerns from – and scant connections to – the professional journals that can make or break an academic/scientific career?
mandarin: 但那些研究重点迥异且与今天能造就或毁灭学术/科研生涯的专业期刊鲜有联系的科学家和其他学者（比方说中东学者）又该怎么办？

english: Scholars and institutions with high publishing rates in the established journals receive better productivity scores, which translate into bigger rewards, in terms of enhanced careers and greater research funding.
mandarin: 在著名期刊拥有高出版率的学者和科研机构效率得分较高，进而在职业生涯发展和研究经费支持方面得到更多奖励。

english: Whether the work they are publishing has a measurable impact on their field of study is, sadly, too often a secondary concern.
mandarin: 但可悲的是，他们所发表的作品对所在研究领域能否产生可以度量的影响却往往不那么被外界关注。

english: The incentives they face mean that quantity often comes before quality.
mandarin: 他们所面临的激励机制意味着数量往往比质量重要。

english: Academic journals determine the various disciplinary rankings that academic institutions are compelled to climb, which leads institutions to hire and retain only those scholars who can produce at high rates.
mandarin: 学术期刊决定科研机构被动研究的学科领域排名，从而导致科研机构仅仅雇佣并保留那些高效率的学者。

english: This has given rise to a deeper, twofold problem: academic journals have become disproportionately influential, and they have placed a premium on empirical research.
mandarin: 由此导致了更深层次的双重问题：学术期刊的影响力已经过于庞大，而且它们过分鼓励实证研究。

english: With respect to the first problem, journals are gradually replacing institutions as the arbiters of quality within academic communities.
mandarin: 在第一个问题上，期刊正逐步取代科研机构成为学术成果质量的评判者。

english: Scholars in almost any discipline seeking jobs at “A-level” institutions must publish in a select few A-level journals that are seen as gateways.
mandarin: 几乎任何领域想在“A级”研究机构求职的学者都必须在几本被公认为入门通道的A级杂志上发表研究成果。

english: These journals’ editorial boards increasingly privilege positivist theoretical work – meaning research that is based on empirical data analysis.
mandarin: 上述期刊的编辑委员会越来越偏爱实证主义理论研究作品 — — 也就是说以实证数据分析为基础的研究。

english: Qualitative research – such as ethnographies, participatory surveys, and case studies – is often designated as suitable only for B- and C-level journals.
mandarin: 定性研究 — — 如民族志、参与性调查和案例研究等 — — 往往被定性为只适合B级或C级期刊发表。

english: Academics conducting empirical research have a big advantage over those carrying out qualitative work, because they can use efficient software and powerful computers to test their hypotheses quickly and account for different variables in data sets.
mandarin: 相比那些从事定性研究的学者，从事实证研究的学者优势非常显著。 因为他们可以使用高效软件和功能强大的电脑来快速测试假设，并计算数据集中不同变量的影响。

english: This kind of work can be cheaper, too, because a single data set can generate multiple journal articles.
mandarin: 此类工作也可以降低成本，因为单个数据集可以产出多篇期刊文章。

english: To be sure, there is nothing wrong with scientific practices evolving along with technology, or with academics using richer data sets and better software.
mandarin: 可以肯定，科学实践随技术演进、抑或学术界使用更丰富的数据集和更先进的软件都属于正常现象。

english: But adoption of this quantitative approach should not be the single most important criterion for assessing scientific excellence and deciding career trajectories.
mandarin: 但这种定量方法的采用不应成为评估科学卓越性和决定职业轨迹的唯一重要的衡量指标。

english: After all, knowledge is acquired in different ways, and empirical positivism is only one method in a larger epistemological inventory.
mandarin: 毕竟知识是以不同方式取得的，而经验实证主义仅仅是广义认识论宝库中的一项法则。

english: The positivist trend in science today is particularly problematic for developing countries, where data sets are scarce and often of poor quality.
mandarin: 今天的实证主义趋势对发展中国家而言问题尤为严重，因为发展中国家不仅数据集稀缺，而且往往质量较差。

english: Thus, scientists working in developing countries face a dilemma: either work on rich-world problems for which there is abundant data, or risk career advancement by conducting qualitative work that will not make it into A-level journals.
mandarin: 因此，在发展中国家工作的科学家们面临着囚徒困境：或者研究有着丰富数据的富裕国家问题，或者甘冒职业生涯之险而进行无缘进入A级期刊的定性研究。

english: Academics who move from data-rich countries in Europe and North America to data-poor countries in the Middle East and elsewhere often face this problem.
mandarin: 从欧洲和北美等数据丰富国家迁往中东等数据贫乏国家的学者往往面临着这样的问题。

english: As researchers at my institution in Abu Dhabi know, conducting surveys for qualitative research is feasible; but generating rich data from scratch for theory-building research is extremely difficult.
mandarin: 正如阿布扎比我所在科研机构的研究人员所知的那样，采集调研数据用于进行定性研究尚属可行；但从零开始搜集理论建设研究所需的丰富数据却是极其困难的。

english: At the International Conference on Science and Technology Indicators this year, a French academic researching soil in Africa reported that only 5% of the published work in his field has originated from African researchers.
mandarin: 在今年召开的科学技术指标国际���议上，一位研究非洲土壤的法国学者报告在他所研究的领域，仅有5%的出版作品来自非洲研究者。

english: When he dug deeper into his own research, he found that 50% of what he had learned about African soil came from African researchers, who have not or could not publish their work in international academic journals.
mandarin: 但当他深入研究自己的研究成果时，却发现他对非洲土壤的认识有50%来自非洲研究者，而这些研究人员的成果没有也不可能在国际学术期刊上发表。

english: Countries where English is not the lingua franca are particularly disadvantaged in science, not because they lack academic excellence, but because English-language journals call the shots.
mandarin: 英语不是通用语的国家在科研方面处境尤其不利，这绝非因为他们学术科研水平不高，而是因为科学界由英语期刊来扮演发号施令的角色。

english: Non-English academic journals simply do not command the same attention in the science community.
mandarin: 非英语学术期刊在科学界根本得不到同样的关注。

english: As a result, the scope of research topics that many countries can undertake is limited, and they must struggle to retain scientific talent.
mandarin: 结果导致许多国家可以进行的研究课题范围有限，因此必须拼尽全力才能将科研人才留在本国。

english: This is particularly true in the Middle East, where governments are struggling to diversify their economies, in order to make them more resilient.
mandarin: 中东地区的情况尤其如此，各国政府正努力实现经济多样化，从而使国民经济适应性得到提高。

english: As English-language empirical-research journals consolidate their hold on the channels that determine whether or not a scientist will have a successful career, developing countries will have to invest heavily in their own data infrastructure to place domestic researchers on a more competitive footing.
mandarin: 因为英语实证研究期刊进一步增强了对科学家能否取得职业成功渠道的控制，发展中国家必须大量投资于国内数据基础设施，才能使国内研究人员处在更具竞争力的科研地位上。

english: But even – or especially – if developing countries do make such investments, much will be lost to science.
mandarin: 但即使 — — 或者尤其 — — 如果发展中国家确实进行这样的投资，将给科研领域造成非常严重的后果。

english: With (mostly) United States-based academic journals reigning over global science, no one has to move to become part of a new brain drain, whereby scientists’ research priorities, problems, and methods gravitate to the dominant positivist epistemology, at the expense of all alternatives.
mandarin: 因为统治全球科学的学术期刊（多数）来自美国，科学家不用实际迁移就会成为新人才流失的组成部分，科学家的研究重点、问题和方法将会牺牲其他选择而转向目前占主导地位的实证主义认识研究。

english: Closing the Financial Services’ Accessibility Gap
mandarin: 填补金融服务普及差距

english: KAMPALA – Last month, the United Kingdom hosted the first-ever Global Disability Summit to help focus the world’s attention on the needs of people with disabilities.
mandarin: 坎帕拉—上个月，英国举办了首届全球残疾峰会，帮助世界聚焦残障人士的需要。

english: The agenda was packed with topics like building equitable education, ending discrimination, and bringing technology to disabled communities – especially poor countries in the Global South.
mandarin: 会议日程包括构建平等教育、消除歧视、为残疾人士带去技术等话题 — — 特别是针对全球南方的穷国。

english: But one challenge that did not receive the attention it deserved is an often-overlooked component of development policy: access to financial services.
mandarin: 但有一个挑战没有受到应有的关注，那就是常常被忽略的发展政策要素：金融服务的普及。

english: This was a missed opportunity – not only for the world’s one billion disabled people, but also for the institutions that should be serving them.
mandarin: 这是一个措施的机会 — — 不仅对于全球十亿残障人士是如此，对应该为他们提供服务的机构亦然。

english: Increasing the accessibility of financial services is good for business and economic growth.
mandarin: 金融服务的日益普及对于商业和经济增长都是好事。

english: According to research by Barclays, when customers with disabilities are able to manage their money, economic vulnerability declines and overall economic health improves.
mandarin: 据巴克莱银行（Barclays）的研究，如果残障客户能够管理他们的钱，经济脆弱性就能减少，总体经济健康就能改善。

english: Moreover, with more than $1 trillion in disposable income, the so-called disability market is among the biggest potential client bases in the world. In other words, financial-service providers have every reason to cater to people with disabilities.
mandarin: 此外，所谓的残疾市场拥有超1万亿美元的可支配收入，是全球最大的潜在客户群体之一。

english: Why, then, are most businesses doing just the opposite?
mandarin: 那么，为什么大部分企业要反其道而行之？

english: One reason is a lack of awareness.
mandarin: 一个原因是缺乏认识。

english: Because people with disabilities typically have less income than their nondisabled peers, service providers have often lacked an incentive to extend support to them.
mandarin: 残障人士通常比无残障人士收入更少，因此服务提供商常常缺少将支持覆盖到他们的激励。

english: But, with more attention being paid to total market potential, financial institutions are starting to adjust their product lines accordingly.
mandarin: 但是，随着市场总潜力获得越来越多的关注，金融机构也开始调整产品线。

english: As they do, four issues must be addressed to maximize the benefits for customers with accessibility challenges.
mandarin: 在此过程中，为了存在金融服务普及困难的客户的利益，必须解决四个问题。

english: First, financial-services companies must work harder to understand the needs of current and future clients.
mandarin: 首先，金融服务公司必须更加努力地理解当前和未来客户需求。

english: For example, with better data, a bank in a particular market could improve the accessibility of its mobile-banking platforms.
mandarin: 比如，有了更好的数据，某个市场中的银行就能改善移动银行平台的普及。

english: This is essentially what happened at Standard Chartered Bank in India last year, when employees developed a voice-assisted system to help visually impaired customers access their accounts online.
mandarin: 去年渣打银行在印度就是这么做的，其员工开发了语音辅助系统帮助视觉障碍客户能够获得在线账户。

english: Good data are also essential to the effectiveness of advocacy groups as they push providers to improve their services.
mandarin: 好数据对于利益推动组织敦促供应商改善服务的效率也至关重要。

english: Second, engagement must not stop with innovative products; it must also be extended to the labor market.
mandarin: 其次，参与决不能只限于创新产品；还必须扩大到劳动力市场。

english: Simply put, the financial-services industry should hire more people with disabilities by investing in assistive technologies like braille readers and alternative and augmentative communication devices.
mandarin: 简言之，金融服务业应该雇用更多残障人士，投资于盲文阅读器等辅助技术和另类和增强沟通设备。

english: The need to diversify the workforce is particularly acute in the United States, where one in five people has a disability.
mandarin: 员工多样化的需求在美国尤其紧急，五分之一的美国人身带残疾。

english: Third, people with disabilities must always be included in discussions about how to expand and strengthen financial independence.
mandarin: 第三，必须一直将残障人士纳入关于如何扩大和加强金融独立性的讨论中。

english: In 2013, when the Lloyds Banking Group convened a focus group to examine the effects of dementia on customer behavior, engagement with clients led to the charter on Dementia-friendly Financial Services.
mandarin: 2013年，劳埃德银行集团（Lloyds Banking Group）组建了一个焦点小组考察痴呆对客户行为的影响，与客户的交流最后形成了痴呆友好金融服务章程。

english: This innovative document codified how banks should tailor products to clients with cognitive impairments.
mandarin: 这份创新文件规定了银行应该如何定制产品为认知障碍客户服务。

english: Future initiatives should follow this collaborative model to ensure that decision-making at all levels is facilitated by human-centered design.
mandarin: 未来方案应该遵循这一合作模式以确保各层次决策都有以人为本设计的推动。

english: And, lastly, governments must commit to addressing this issue, by emulating the action of countries like the UK, which has linked services for the disabled to development funding.
mandarin: 最后，政府应该致力于解决这一问题，效仿英国等国家的措施。 英国将残障人士服务与发展拨款挂钩。

english: With the right support, progress on these complex challenges can be sweeping; for example, at Financial Sector Deepening Uganda, where I work, we are using British aid money to extend financial services to the disabled in rural communities.
mandarin: 有了正确的支持，这些复杂挑战就能取得决定性的进展；比如，在我供职的乌干达金融业深化组织（Financial Sector Deepening Uganda ） ， 我们用英国援助资金扩大农村地区残障人士的金融服务。

english: Our vision is to encourage the emergence of similar programs in many other countries around the world.
mandarin: 我们的愿景是鼓励其他国家也出现类似的项目。

english: With 91 countries having already ratified the Optional Protocol to the Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities, it is clear that there is plenty of political support for these initiatives.
mandarin: 已有91个国家签署了残疾人权利共约可选议定书，显然对于这些项目有足够的政治支持。

english: The challenge now is to turn pledges into action.
mandarin: 现在的挑战是如何将承诺兑现为行动。

english: In the coming decades, the world’s disabled population will grow as medical advances allow people to live longer, healthier, fuller lives.
mandarin: 在未来几十年中，随着医学进步让人活得更长久、更健康、更充实，世界残障人口数量也会增长。

english: Providing the disabled with access to financial services and products is among the best ways to guard against discrimination and nurture long-term empowerment.
mandarin: 让残障人士活得金融服务和产品是防止歧视、促进长期赋能的最佳办法之一。

english: Full financial inclusion will come slowly for a community often referred to as the “fastest-growing minority group in the world.”
mandarin: 这一通常被称为“全球增长最快的少数群体”的完全的金融包容正在缓慢实现。

english: The task for activists, advocates, enlightened business leaders, and policymakers is to highlight the social and economic benefits of success.
mandarin: 活动家、提倡者、开明商界领袖和决策者的任务是强调成功的社会和经济利益。

english: Surgery for All
mandarin: 让每个人都能手术

english: BOSTON – On a recent trip to India, I hailed a rickshaw that was pedaled, I soon noticed, by a man with a lame leg.
mandarin: 波士顿 — — 不久前，去印度旅行时，我雇了一辆脚踏的黄包车，我很快就发现，车夫的腿是瘸的。

english: It turns out that a few weeks earlier, the driver had been hit by a car while navigating the busy streets of New Delhi.
mandarin: 原来在几周前，车夫在新德里繁忙的街道上穿行时被一辆汽车撞了。

english: Although he had managed to obtain medication from a local pharmacy for the agonizing pain – probably because his leg was broken – he could spare neither the time nor the money to see a surgeon.
mandarin: 尽管他也设法从当地药房拿到了止痛药 — — 这样的剧烈疼痛可能因为他的腿断了 — — 但他既没有时间也没有钱去看外科。

english: This type of tragic calculus is strikingly common.
mandarin: 这种充满悲剧性的考量其普遍程度令人震惊。

english: The Lancet Commission on Global Surgery estimates that some five billion people – almost 70% of the world’s population – lack access to safe, affordable surgical and anesthetic care, while 33 million people are saddled with unbearably high health expenses.
mandarin: 据柳叶刀全球外科委员会估计，约有50亿人 — — 几乎占到全球人口总数的70 % — —都无法获得安全、经济的手术和麻醉服务，而高达3，300万人则背负着无法承受的高额医疗费用。

english: Not surprisingly, the global poor suffer disproportionately: while low-income countries are home to close to 35% of humanity, they account for just 3.5% of all surgical procedures.
mandarin: 不出所料，受影响的绝大多数集中在全球贫困人口：虽然低收入国家占全球人口总数的近35 % ， 但在能接受外科手术的人当中却仅占3.5%的份额。

english: One of the biggest obstacles to achieving universal health coverage – which the United Nations has declared a global goal – is financing.
mandarin: 融资是实现全民医疗覆盖一个最大的障碍 — — 已经被联合国宣布为全球目标。

english: And, paradoxical as it may sound, one of the best ways that governments can get the money they need to expand coverage is by making surgery more widely available.
mandarin: 而且，听上去可能有些自相矛盾，政府可以获得扩大覆盖资金的一种最佳方式就是扩大手术的覆盖范围。

english: Time-sensitive health problems – such as injuries from traffic accidents and pregnancy-related complications – are among the leading causes of death and disability in low- and middle-income countries.
mandarin: 时间敏感度相对较高的健康问题 — — 例如交通事故伤害和因妊娠引起的并发症 — — 是导致中低收入国家死亡和残疾的主要原因之一。

english: But untreated or undertreated conditions requiring surgery also hurt economic productivity.
mandarin: 但未经治疗或治疗不足然而却需要手术的病情同样有损经济生产力。

english: For example, the Lancet study estimated that the failure to improve surgical care in developing countries would translate into $12.3 trillion of lost economic output by 2030.
mandarin: 例如，据柳叶刀研究估计，未能改善发展中国家的手术治疗截止2030年可以导致12.3万亿美元的巨额经济产出损失。

english: Failure to maintain strong surgical capacity could even undercut economic gains made by middle-income countries, reducing total GDP growth by approximately 2% annually.
mandarin: 无法维持强大的手术能力甚至可能削弱中等收入国家所取得的经济效益，每年影响约2%的总GDP增长率。

english: For many leaders, the common perception is that provision of surgical care is not sustainable or cost-effective.
mandarin: 许多领导人普遍认为提供外科手术既不可持续也不具备成本效益。

english: When faced with tough budget choices, governments often favor programs that combat infectious and chronic diseases, leaving people like my rickshaw driver in the lurch.
mandarin: 因此当面临艰难的预算选择时，政府往往更倾向于抗击慢性及传染性疾病的项目，从而导致像我的人力车夫那样的民众陷入困境。

english: But a growing body of evidence suggests that these views are misplaced.
mandarin: 但越来越多的证据表明，这样的观点并不正确。

english: When researchers at the Harvard Medical School analyzed surgical interventions in low- and middle-income countries, they found a remarkable disconnect between economic assumptions and reality.
mandarin: 当哈佛大学医学院的研究人员分析中低收入国家的外科手术干预时，他们发现经济假设和现实之间存在非常显著的脱节 。

english: For example, they calculated that money spent on cesarean sections and joint surgeries yields higher returns than spending on the management of HIV or heart disease.
mandarin: 例如，他们计算出花在剖腹产和联合手术上的经费比花在艾滋病毒或心脏病管理方面的经费能够带来更高的效益。

english: To be sure, chronic and infectious diseases need our attention, too; we cannot restructure health systems overnight, nor should we turn our backs on those being treated for non-surgical illnesses.
mandarin: 可以肯定，慢性及传染性疾病也需要引起我们的重视；我们无法在一夜之间重组整个卫生系统，而且我们也不应当抛弃那些因为非手术型疾病而接受治疗的人。

english: But reforms that focus more attention on the importance of surgery would boost economic productivity and help create more equitable health care for everyone.
mandarin: 但更多关注手术重要性的改革可以提高经济生产率，并有助于为所有人创造更加公平的医疗环境。

english: For starters, health ministries and physician organizations should formally recognize that surgical and anesthetic care are an essential part of universal health coverage.
mandarin: 首先，卫生部和医生联合会应当正式承认，手术和麻醉护理是全民医疗覆盖的重要组成部分之一。

english: To make this case, health-care providers will need to improve their collection and analysis of data on surgical outcomes, which would increase transparency on mortality and morbidity and strengthen overall accountability.
mandarin: 为证明这一点，医疗保健提供机构应加强他们对手术结果数据的搜集和分析，这样做可以增加死亡率和发病率等数据的透明度，并强化问责制。

english: Decisions about how to expand services could be guided by the Lancet commission’s core indicators on “preparedness,” “delivery,” and “impact” of surgical care.
mandarin: 柳叶刀委员会有关外科治疗“术前准备 ” 、 “术中实施”和“术后影响”的核心指标可以用来指导扩大手术服务的决策。

english: Second, to pool risk and guard against cost overruns, countries that are considering universal coverage policies should put surgical care under publicly financed plans.
mandarin: 其次，为集中风险并防范成本超支，正在考虑全民覆盖政策的国家应在公共资助计划中纳入外科医疗服务。

english: While some funding for expanding surgical services could come from taxation, health-care providers should also explore innovative financing options – such as “social justice models,” whereby people pay according to their means.
mandarin: 虽然扩大手术服务的部分资金可以来源于税收，但医疗保健机构也应当探索创新融资方式 — — 即民众可以根据自身经济条件支付的“社会公平模式 ” 。

english: Finally, to streamline resources and increase surgical capacity, hospitals should explore task-sharing, whereby non-emergency cases are referred to licensed nurses and physician assistants.
mandarin: 最后，为简化资源运用并强化手术能力，医院应探索任务共享，将非紧急病例转诊至持证护士和医师助理。

english: Longer-term strategies include investing more in medical education to bolster the ranks of doctors and surgeons.
mandarin: 更为长期的策略包括加大在医学教育领域的资金投入，以建设医生和外科医师队伍。

english: The tremendous economic progress that many developing countries have made in recent decades has been largely driven by vibrant, young, and ambitious populations.
mandarin: 充满活力和雄心勃勃的年轻人一直推动着近几十年来强势的经济崛起。

english: One of the most effective ways to maintain this growth and development is to ensure access to safe and affordable healthcare – including surgery.
mandarin: 保持这种增长和发展最有效的手段之一是确保人们能够得到包括手术在内的安全和廉价的医疗服务。

english: While the cost of providing it may be high, the cost of not providing it is even higher.
mandarin: 虽然提供手术服务的成本可能很高，但与不提供手术服务的代价却完全无法相比。

english: Polluters Must Pay
mandarin: 污染者必须负责

english: NEW YORK – When BP and its drilling partners caused the Deepwater Horizon oil spill in the Gulf of Mexico in 2010, the United States government demanded that BP finance the cleanup, compensate those who suffered damages, and pay criminal penalties for the violations that led to the disaster.
mandarin: 发自纽约 — — 当英国石油公司及其搭档瑞士越洋钻探公司于2010年在墨西哥湾引发“深水地平线”漏油事故时，美国政府不但要求英国石油公司承担油污清理费用，赔偿受害者损失，还要为导致此次灾难的违规行为接受刑事处罚。

english: BP has already committed more than $20 billion in remediation and penalties.
mandarin: 英国石油公司已经为该事故调拨了200多亿美元用于善后补救工作和交纳罚金。

english: Based on a settlement last week, BP will now pay the largest criminal penalty in US history – $4.5 billion.
mandarin: 根据上周达成的协议，英国石油公司将支付美国历史上最大的一 笔刑事罚款 — — 45亿美元。

english: The same standards for environmental cleanup need to be applied to global companies operating in poorer countries, where their power has typically been so great relative to that of governments that many act with impunity, wreaking havoc on the environment with little or no accountability.
mandarin: 同样的环境事故清理善后标准也应运用到那些在贫困国家经营的国际企业身上。 这些大公司的势力相对当地政府来说通常极为巨大，以致许多公司都是在豁免权下活动，可以对环境造成严重破坏却极少或无需承担责任。

english: As we enter a new era of sustainable development, impunity must turn to responsibility.
mandarin: 随着我们进入一个可持续发展的新时代，豁免权应该转向责任制。

english: Polluters must pay, whether in rich or poor countries.
mandarin: 不管是在富国还是穷国，污染者必须付出代价。

english: Major companies need to accept responsibility for their actions.
mandarin: 大公司应该为它们的行为承担相应的责任。

english: Nigeria has been Exhibit A of corporate environmental impunity.
mandarin: 尼日利亚就曾经是企业逍遥于环境污染惩罚之外的例子。

english: For decades, major oil companies, including Shell, ExxonMobil, and Chevron, have been producing oil in the Niger Delta, an ecologically fragile environment of freshwater swamp forests, mangroves, lowland rainforests, and coastal barrier islands.
mandarin: 几十年来，包括壳牌、埃克森美孚和雪弗龙在内的各大石油公司一直在尼日尔三角洲开采石油。 尼日尔三角洲是一个拥有淡水沼泽森林、红树林、低地雨林和沿海屏障岛屿的脆弱生态环境。

english: This rich habitat supports remarkable biodiversity – or did before the oil companies got there – and more than 30 million local inhabitants, who depend on the local ecosystems for their health and livelihoods.
mandarin: 这片肥沃富饶的栖息地支撑着非凡的生物多样性 — — 或者说在石油公司来破坏之前是这样的 — — 而当地3000多万居民的健康和生计都依赖于该生态系统。

english: Twenty years ago, the International Union for Conservation of Nature and Natural Resources classified the Niger Delta as a region of high biodiversity of marine and coastal flora and fauna – tree species, fish, birds, and mammals, among other forms of life – and therefore rated it as a very high priority for conservation.
mandarin: 二十年前，世界自然保护联盟把尼日尔三角洲分类为一个拥有极丰富海洋及沿海动植物多样性的地区 — — 不同树种、鱼类、鸟类和哺乳类与其他形式的生命共处一地 — — 因此将其列为极高的优先保护等级。

english: Yet it also noted that the region’s biodiversity was under massive threat, with little or no protection.
mandarin: 然而该联盟也指出，由于这个地区极少或未被保护，其生物多样性正处于巨大的威胁之中。

english: The global companies operating in the delta have spilled oil and flared natural gas for decades, without regard for the natural environment and the communities impoverished and poisoned by their actions.
mandarin: 在尼日尔三角洲经营的跨国石油企业几十年来一直在该地区泄漏石油及燃烧天然气，根本不考虑自然环境和因其行为而变得贫困甚至遭受毒害的人类社区。

english: One estimate puts the cumulative spills over the past 50 years at approximately 10 million barrels – twice the size of the BP spill.
mandarin: 一份研究估计宣称过去50年中这些公司累积泄漏的石油约为1000万桶 — — 这是英国石油公司漏油量的2倍。

english: The data are uncertain: there have been many thousands of spills during this period – often poorly documented and their magnitude hidden or simply unmeasured by either the companies or the government.
mandarin: 该数据并不准确：过去的50年中有好几千次石油溢出事故 — — 通常这些事故都未被详细记录，其石油泄漏量常常被掩盖甚至被公司及政府故意忽略。

english: Indeed, just as BP was being hit with new criminal penalties, ExxonMobil announced yet another pipeline leak in the Niger Delta.
mandarin: 确实，正当英国石油公司遭受新的刑事处罚时，埃克森美孚又通报了一起位于尼日尔三角洲的石油管道泄漏事件。

english: The environmental destruction of the delta is part of a larger saga: corrupt companies operating hand in hand with corrupt government officials.
mandarin: 三角洲的环境破坏只是一长串事件中的一部分：腐败的公司与腐败的政府官员相互勾结以牟取私利。

english: The companies routinely bribe officials to gain oil leases, lie about output, evade taxes, and dodge responsibility for the environmental damage that they cause.
mandarin: 公司通常贿赂政府官员以获取石油合同，它们谎报产量，偷税漏税，逃避由其经营活动引起的环境损害的责任。

english: Nigerian officials have become fabulously wealthy, owing to decades of payoffs by international companies that have plundered the delta’s natural wealth.
mandarin: 由于一直掠夺三角洲自然财富的跨国企业几十年来的贿赂，尼日利亚的政府官员变得惊人的富有。

english: Shell, the largest foreign operator in the Niger Delta, has been criticized repeatedly for its egregious practices and its unwillingness to be held to account.
mandarin: 壳牌 — — 尼日尔三角洲最大的国外营运商 — — 就屡次因其恶名昭彰的行为及不愿承担责任的态度而遭到外界批评。

english: Meanwhile, the local population has remained impoverished and beset by diseases caused by unsafe air, poisoned drinking water, and pollution in the food chain.
mandarin: 与此同时，当地居民却一直处于贫困状态，还被由不安全的空气、被污染的饮用水和食物链污染引起的疾病所困扰。

english: Local lawlessness has led to gang warfare and persistent illegal tapping into the pipelines to steal oil, leading to further massive oil spills and frequent explosions that kill dozens, including innocent bystanders.
mandarin: 当地违法行为已经引起了黑帮火拼以及层出不穷的管道偷油案件，这又进一步导致了大量石油泄漏事故并导致了造成大量人员死亡 — — 包括许多无辜受殃者 — — 的频繁爆炸事件。

mandarin: （迪克·切尼就是从哈利伯顿的首席执行官摇身一变成为美国副总统的。 ）

mandarin: 去年，联合国环境规划署发布了一份引人注目的奥贡尼兰报告，奥贡尼兰是一个曾经曾处于本地社区与跨国石油企业矛盾中心的尼日尔三角洲主要部族祖居地。

mandarin: 联合国环境规划署同时还提供了清晰详细的建议，包括保证安全饮用水的紧急措施；针对红树木和土壤的清除活动；鉴定及消除污染后果的公共健康研究；还有一个新的监管框架。

mandarin: 世界各国政府在六月的“里约+20峰会”上宣布他们打算采用可持续发展目标，并于近期同意为了可持续发展接受新的监管框架。

mandarin: 可持续发展目标为全世界给政府及公司行为设定清晰强制的标准提供了一个关键的机会。

mandarin: 包括石油产业在内的许多大公司都表达了他们支持可持续发展目标的意愿。

mandarin: 清除尼日尔三角洲的石油污染将给新时代的问责制提供一个具备最大实施可能性的例子。

mandarin: 壳牌、雪弗龙、埃克森美孚以及其他石油大公司应该站出来资助必要的石油污染清理，开创一个负责任的新时代。

english: The Nigerian government’s own accountability is on the line as well.
mandarin: 尼日利亚政府本身也有不可推卸的责任。

mandarin: 令人鼓舞的是已经有几位尼日利亚参议员最近一直站在致力加强石油产业法治化的最前沿。

english: The cleanup of the Niger Delta provides an ideal opportunity for Nigeria, the oil industry, and the international community to show convincingly that a new age has dawned.
mandarin: 尼日尔三角洲的石油清理行动给尼日利亚、石油产业以及国际社会提供了一个理想的机会来向世界昭示 — — 一个新的时代已经到来了。

mandarin: 从现在开始，可持续发展不能纯粹只是一个口号，而应该是针对全球治理及在这个浮躁拥挤的星球上谋求幸福的运作方法。

english: Saving Capitalism from Economics 101
mandarin: 让资本主义免遭“经济学入门”课的荼毒

english: WASHINGTON, DC – All across the United States, students are settling into college – and coming to grips with “Econ 101.”
mandarin: 发自华盛顿特区 — — 在全美各地，新生们正在进入大学 — — 并开始接触“经济学入门”课程。

english: This introductory course is typically taught with a broadly reassuring message: if markets are allowed to work, good outcomes – such as productivity growth, increasing wages, and generally shared prosperity – will surely follow.
mandarin: 这门入门课程通常会教授一个在很大程度上令人放心的信息：如果允许市场发挥作用，就必然会获得良好的结果 — — 如生产力增长、工资增长以及大众普遍共享的繁荣。

english: Unfortunately, as my co-author James Kwak points out in his recent book, Economism: Bad Economics and the Rise of Inequality, Econ 101 is so far from being the whole story that it could actually be considered misleading – at least as a guide to sensible policymaking.
mandarin: 不幸的是，正如我某本著作的合著者詹姆斯·郭（James Kwak）在其新书《经济学主义：坏经济学和不平等的兴起》中所指出的那样 ， “ 经济学入门”远远无法涵盖这门学科的所有内容，甚至如果拿来指导明智政策制定的话，实际上可以被认为是存在误导性的。

english: Markets can be good, but they are also profoundly susceptible to abusive practices, including by prominent private-sector people.
mandarin: 市场有可能是好的，但它们也极易受到各类滥用行为的影响 — — 有些甚至出自知名私营部门从业者之手。

english: This is not a theoretical concern; it is central to our current policy debates, including important new US legislation that has just been put forward.
mandarin: 这不是理论上的问题；它是我们当前政策辩论的核心，包括刚刚提出的重要新立法法案​​。

english: One core problem is that market incentives reward self-interested private behavior, without accounting for social benefits or costs.
mandarin: 一个核心问题是市场激励机制会奖励那些自利的个人行为，而不考虑社会的利益或成本。

english: We generally overlook our actions’ spillover effects on others, or “externalities.”
mandarin: 我们通常忽略了自身行为对他人的溢出效应或“外部性 ” 。

english: To be fair, Econ 101 textbooks do discuss this issue in some contexts, such as pollution, and it is widely accepted that environmental damage needs to be regulated if we are to have clean air, clean water, and limits on other pollutants.
mandarin: “初级经济学”教科书虽然确实在某些事件背景下（例如污染）讨论过这一问题，而人们也普遍同意：如果想拥有洁净空气、洁净的水以及减少其他污染物，就需要对破坏环境行为加以规管。

english: Unfortunately, “widely accepted” does not include by President Donald Trump’s administration, which is busy rolling back environmental protections across a broad range of activities.
mandarin: 不幸的是，特朗普总统的政府并不在这一“普遍同意”的行列中，因为该政府正忙于在一系列活动中废止环保措施。

english: The New York Times counts 76 rollbacks in progress.
mandarin: 《纽约时报》报道说目前有76个废止程序正在进行中。

english: The thinking behind this policy is straight out of the first few weeks of Econ 101: get out of the way of the market.
mandarin: 而这一政策背后的理念直接来自“经济学入门”的带头几个章节：别去打扰市场。

english: As a result, there is a lot more pollution – including more emission of greenhouse gases – in America’s future.
mandarin: 在此之下美国只会迎来更严重的污染 — — 包括更多的温室气体排放。

english: There is also an even deeper problem.
mandarin: 这里还存在一个更深层次的问题。

english: There is a general presumption in Econ 101 that firms should maximize profits, and that this is best for their shareholders and for society.
